observations.assessment: Readiness consumes warmup one call at a time before checking required motion on scenario frame zero. It requires runtime motion processed and optional playback presentation settled, resets readiness count on failure and requires two successful observations. Other frames return true here. Actual driver earlier authored readiness and harness timeout are separate; processed must be interpreted at its runtime owner before equating with usable motion.

source.purpose: Full Lens 13 capture snapshots, overlay, readiness, repeated evaluation and root/subject motion contracts. Source inspection only.

observations.assessment: First view captures scenario/frame, filtered CapturedBones, skeleton contact/landing sequences, total event vector length and LegIkDiagnostics. Later views compare if baseline exists and monotonically accumulate validity; absent baseline leaves validity unchanged. It does not snapshot all procedural state, root/global target set, timestamps or event payload contents. Expected invariant is selected repeated logical-sample observations, not full-state equality.

Bone comparison rejects missing/extra keys with diagnostic infinity deltas, then computes native position distance and quaternion angle with direct-dot identity shortcut. It uses greater-than tolerance predicates (.0005 m, .05 degrees) without explicit finite checks; nonfinite computed deltas do not necessarily select mismatch. Valid native input/rotation requirements and downstream frame validation must be established before promoting a reachable acceptance bypass. Finite nonunit frames are not globally forbidden by this observation.

IK comparison checks optional target vectors and support/settle fractions with <= tolerances, explicit release booleans and plain yaw differences. None/None matches, presence mismatch fails. Numeric NaN handling differs from greater-than bone mismatch; supported diagnostics producers and required presence still determine validity. Plain successful-zero yaw cannot encode missing observation.

Tests read only: missing/extra bone key fixture actually calls mismatch and checks identical moderate sample. Hidden-IK-state-mutation test only assert_ne on baseline versus changed diagnostics; it never calls repeated_leg_ik_matches or record_repeated_evaluation. No tolerance boundaries, native nonfinite input, missing baseline or complete multi-view scheduling acceptance is shown.

source.purpose: Full Lens 13 capture snapshots, overlay, readiness, repeated evaluation and root/subject motion contracts. Source inspection only.

observations.assessment: CaptureGround explicitly selects terrain or checked authored plane. collect_bones filters owner and reportable roles, copies raw global position/rotation and optional terrain clearance. Invalid terrain footprint or missing terrain sample becomes absent clearance; complete position and rotation are not admitted here. The authored-plane path remains a deliberate alternate observation authority, not a terrain fallback. Duplicate roles and native decomposition require producer guarantees.

Initial root requires origin terrain height and checked completed position before replacing translation/rotation while retaining scale. Fixture root admits completed horizontal footprint before height query and completed XYZ before Bevy. Quickstep always requires terrain; enabled IK uses required height, disabled ordinary mode retains current Y. Positive checked result is the boundary, not each intermediate native multiplication.

Ragdoll fixture uses bounded smoothstep of scenario index to compose root rotation and checked complete translation. Index+4 and native rotations rely on actual bounded authored plan. capture_ground with disabled IK admits root-derived SupportElevation and rejects invalid elevation explicitly, never silently selects terrain. Enabled terrain returns Terrain authority; individual bone clearance remains optional in collection.

source.purpose: Full Lens 13 capture snapshots, overlay, readiness, repeated evaluation and root/subject motion contracts. Source inspection only.

observations.assessment: CaptureMotion retains typed elapsed/contact and native orientation/velocity. Facing assigns only successful advance_body_facing outside posture transition. Motion input is admitted before controller projection; jump state updates after success. Posture advancement can mutate skeleton before a fallible facing delta, and final rotation product is normalized natively with no local completed finite admission. Actual authored inputs and downstream terminal rejection define applicability; no unbounded invalid fixture witness assumed.

Fixture action start is explicit by action and frame; contact tick saturating-adds 19 attack or 64 ordinary action ticks, quickstep half-span separately. Actual begin_attack/dodge/block and quickstep direction errors are asserted with expect rather than propagated here. This is source policy requiring actual authored plan/tick/state bounds and applicable crate-rule reconciliation, not proof that valid finite fixture inputs fail. No backward-compatible runtime alias is introduced by these actions.
